description: This file defines the SystemInfo class and related nested classes within the WPEFramework::PluginHost namespace. It provides interfaces and implementations for system information components such as identifiers, provisioning, internet, security, location, and time, along with event handling and notification mechanisms.

classes.name: SystemInfo
classes.description: Main class providing system information and event notification functionalities within the PluginHost namespace.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Id
classes.description: Represents a system identifier with methods to set and retrieve device-specific identification data.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Provisioning
classes.description: Iterator wrapper for provisioning information, managing storage labels and data.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Internet
classes.description: Represents internet connectivity information, including IP address and network type.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Security
classes.description: Represents security-related information such as callsign.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Location
classes.description: Holds geographic location data including timezone, country, region, city, latitude, and longitude.

methods.name: SystemInfo::BuildTreeHash
methods.description: Generates a hash representing the system's configuration tree.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Version
methods.description: Returns the version string of the system information.

methods.name: SystemInfo::SecurityCallsign
methods.description: Retrieves the security callsign associated with the system.
